title: Metaphysical Insight Extraction
definition: The process of extracting high-level philosophical concepts from a conversation, focusing on their core insights.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine you're reading a book of deep thoughts. This is like pulling out the main ideas or themes from it, even if they're complex.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Metaphysical insight extraction involves identifying key philosophical concepts from a conversation, focusing on their underlying definitions and interrelationships.
difficulty_levels.expert: This is a process that extracts philosophical concepts from a conversation, focusing on their core insights. It involves a philosophical understanding of the domain, edge case considerations, and connections to other fields such as linguistics and AI.

extra_fields.insight: The conversation revealed a new, high-level philosophical concept related to the extraction of insights from language.
